constraints.text: Effects (contribute, book, save-pick) run only after a click on a toll booth. Amounts, slots, and picks come from user input or pack data, never from LLM text.
Every stretch, including deterministic fallback stretches and injected demo stretches, passes the same compiler with the active pack invariants before it renders.
The LLM never writes facts. Claim text renders only from the active pack facts table or from tool result rows, by ID. Every LLM label passes the grounded-text guard.
Every compiler invariant has at least one fixture that the compiler rejects, and `npm run lab -- fixtures` exits 1 if any fixture result is wrong.
A 401, 402, or 403 from the model API stops all later model calls for the session. The road continues on the fallback paver.
The sun-life pack shows a crisis exit (call or text 9-8-8) on every stretch and never renders a clinical claim.
road-lab follows playground/AGENTS.md: self-contained prototype folder, design tokens only, tap targets of 44 px or more, works at 375 px, and `npm run check` passes.
